name: Lvgl → Animation Stop
description: Stops one or more running animations, leaving the animated properties at their current values. The `on_stop` automation runs for each animation that was running. Stopping an animation that is not running has no effect.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the animation to stop, or a list of IDs.

config_entries.label: Lvgl ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the LVGL instance the animations belong to. Only required when more than one LVGL instance is configured.
